stepExplanation: This is a **missense mutation** (also called a substitution mutation). One amino acid is replaced by another: Proline (CCU) is replaced by Leucine (CUU). This may affect protein structure and function depending on how different the amino acids are.
stepBody: CCU codes for Proline and CUU codes for Leucine - two different amino acids. What type of mutation is this? (Options: silent, missense, nonsense, frameshift)
